summary: Implement Tiered Loyalty Discounts (VIP 20%) & Defensive Voucher Validation in Checkout Engine
description: As the Payments Platform team, we need to upgrade the loyalty tier discount structure so VIP Platinum members receive a 20% base discount (upgraded from 10%), while safeguarding the checkout engine with defensive voucher expiration checks and audit logging.

acceptance_criteria.title: VIP Platinum 20% Discount Rate
acceptance_criteria.requirement: CustomerTier.VIP_PLATINUM discount multiplier must be updated to 0.20 (20%). A $100 cart for a VIP customer must calculate a $20.00 discount and an $80.00 final amount.

acceptance_criteria.title: Defensive Voucher Validation & Cap Enforcement
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Vouchers must be verified for is_active == True. If a voucher exceeds max_discount_amount, the discount must be capped at max_discount_amount. Inactive or expired vouchers must not apply any discount.

acceptance_criteria.title: Comprehensive Unit Test Suite
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Unit tests in tests/test_discount_service.py must be updated to validate the 20% VIP Platinum rate ($80 expected on $100), plus new test coverage for inactive voucher rejection and discount capping.

acceptance_criteria.title: Structured Audit Logging
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Each successful discount calculation must emit a structured audit log containing audit_event_id, customer_id, subtotal, and total_discount for financial compliance.
